content.short: Cubane is a SaaS Layer-1 blockchain bringing decentralization to industries such as insurance and media-IPR.
content.description: Cubane advances blockchain adoption by addressing scalability, privacy, and accessibility across industries such as insurance, RWA, and media-IPR. Its Cubic Consensus Mechanism (CCCM) sustains over 1.2M transactions per second, delivering high performance and fault tolerance. Built-in privacy is enabled by technologies like fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) and zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs), protecting sensitive data. For speed to market, Cubane provides a no-code platform to design, build, and deploy decentralized applications.
